newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil quiet on holidays, arb east now shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil quiet on holidays, arb east now shut.

text.p: NWE gas oil was steady to narrowly easier on Thursday with much of continental Europe enjoying public holidays.
May IPE gas oil closed 75 cents lower at $171 a tonne.
Traders said the market was very slow with German buying impetus not really present.
"The Germans have been driving the heating oil market in recent days," said one trader.
DIN was thought to be retaining its recent strength with bids and offers pegged around May IPE +$6-7 cif.

Diesel was also looking firm around May IPE +$14.50 cif although the market was divided between those thinking better supplies into May would bring prices down and others who perceived a longer-term strength on the back of continuing good demand.

The arbitrage window to Asia now looks to have closed which may start to pressurise European prices which have been moving upwards over the last few days. A touch over two million tonnes of European gas oil was drawn eastwards in the two months the window was open, traders said.
